entities.title: What is god-string for, and what comes next?
entities.summary: The README says what the repository holds, not what it is for or whether more will come; only the owner can say.
entities.context: The README calls the repository a recreation of the god-string that was used in iPulse, and it holds a published series of articles and headers marked as speculative. Whether it is finished as a companion to the articles, or will grow (more series, an implementation of the headers), is not written down, and the knowledge catalogue forbids inventing intent.

options.title: The owner states it
options.consequences: A sentence or two becomes vision.json in the root's .dev, with the owner as origin, and wanted work becomes backlog items in the folders that would own it.

options.title: Leave it unstated
options.consequences: The root has no vision; nothing else changes.

origin.description: Found while bringing the repository in line with human-assisted-software-development.
